The Hub card's Galaxy S26 table. Harness = a benchmark script; the bundle pushed is model.litertlm (sha256 read back on the phone after the push, chain log). Each run = one process, litert_lm_advanced_main --benchmark with 1024 prefill / 256 decode tokens, max_num_tokens 2048, 3 iterations; a run's values = the mean of iterations 2-3; cells = the median of the runs, each run's values in metrics (run<n>_*); before each run 123-254 s of rest and the ready check (no CPU or GPU ceiling lowered, thermal status 0 or 1); Init = the binary's Init Total with the caches an earlier process of the hold wrote (cold starts with the caches removed in metrics cold_init<n>_ms); peak = the process VmHWM (the harness's /proc read, kB x 1,024 / 10^6 MB; per run in metrics). The binary is given no activation type (activation_data_type: Not set) and takes the file's fp32 GPU declaration; GPU = LiteRT's OpenCL backend, CPU = XNNPACK at the binary's default thread count. The GPU cells are the card's three 256-token runs (hold s2 21:00-21:24 JST, hold s3 21:57-22:08 JST): the harness's 2-3 s sampler saw the kgsl thermal_pwrlevel above 0 in every one of them (metrics run<n>_gpu_thermal_samples_above_0 of run<n>_gpu_thermal_samples; the first lowered sample 35, 20 and 25 s into the 39-40 s processes, max clock 1,300 to 1,200 / 1,000 / 1,050 MHz) - each started uncapped and clean, no unthrottled 256-token run was obtained in 3 tries; the record says so rather than leaving the GPU cell empty. The two 64-token runs of hold s2 whose GPU clock held are in metrics (d64_run<n>_*), the card quotes them. The CPU cells: hold s1 12:21-12:36 JST (the hold opened at Thermal Status 3 after another run; both benchmark processes started clean after 243 s of rest; the CPU clock ceiling lowered in 17 of 18 and 16 of 17 samples = sustained, as the card says). The phone left adb at 12:45 inside another job's hold and came back at 20:39 with its uptime continuous (no reboot); hold s2's first try (12:45:54, device_absent_at_start, no run) is not a row. Not entered: the fp16 F8pt controls run in the same GPU holds (the same weights without the fp32 declaration, sha256 fc1b00a4..., never shipped) and every earlier form's phone rows (B8, F8, F8p: other bytes); the 8-question runs of run r10d (correctness checks the card quotes: GPU 8/8 and CPU 7/8 on each phone).
